t: Trump Says He Plans to Hold Phone Conversation With Putin in Near Future
d: US President Donald Trump said that he is going to hold a phone conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the near future.

t: Ukraine's External Debt Rises by Almost 500% Under Zelensky
d: Ukraine's external public debt has increased by nearly 500% since late May 2019, when Vladimir Zelensky came to power, according to statistical data analyzed by Sputnik.

t: Russia's Zakharova Condemns Use of Force Against French Student Protesters
d: Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova condemned on Tuesday the use of force by French police against student protesters.

t: Africa Takes Aim at Western Credit-Rating Dominance With New Agency
d: The African Credit Rating Agency (AfCRA) - a project endorsed by African leaders in 2018 – will be headquartered in Mauritius and rate governments, banks and companies.

t: Russia Hits Ships Involved in Supporting Ukrainian Troops Overnight
d: he Russian armed forces struck naval vessels involved in supporting the Ukrainian armed forces overnight, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Wednesday.

t: Rostec Transfers Batch of Su-34 Fighter-Bombers to Russian Army
d: The Russian state corporation Rostec said on Wednesday that it had manufactured and handed over to the Russian Defense Ministry a batch of Su-34 fighter-bombers under a state defense order.

t: Russian Troops Tighten Encirclement & Expand Buffer Zone in Kharkov Region
d: Units of the Sever battlegroup are fighting to liberate the settlements of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Reznikovo, Nefedovka, and Lobanovka in the encircled part of the Kharkov region, the Russian Ministry of Defense reported.

t: Europe Obsessed With Militarization, Turning EU Into Military-Political Bloc - Kremlin
d: Europe is obsessed with militarization and plans to turn the EU into a military-political bloc, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Wednesday.

t: Pezeshkian Sends Birthday Greetings to Putin by Phone
d: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has sent birthday greetings to Russian President Vladimir Putin during a phone conversation, Pezeshkian's office said on Wednesday.

t: With Military Options Exhausted, Iran’s Enemies Take Aim at Its Internal Vulnerability
d: The US-Israeli war has shown that military action “could not inflict damage on Iran,” Tasnim quotes Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf as saying.
